 │   – a vault, or not      │ │            The Candle Harness's day and Candle's on agent-a's key are both $50.00;    │ 
 │   ✓ its key              │ │            the Candle Harness counts from local midnight, Candle from 00:00 UTC.      │

 │   ▸ limits               │ │    Candle  per-asset caps, loss limits, circuit breaker                               │
